responsibility: Supplies the x86 AMX-FP16 intrinsic API for half-precision tile dot-product accumulation. This header is a narrow AMX extension wrapper that exposes _tile_dpfp16ps via inline assembly on x86_64, bridging user intrinsic calls to the AMX FP16 matrix instruction form and isolating this tile-FP16 functionality from the more general AMX tile and BF16 headers.
